objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Register on Pixi and use its API to read the records of other users. An admin user, Flag Keeper, has the flag in its record.
hints: Log in through the API and keep the token it hands out: every endpoint takes it in the x-access-token header.
Some endpoints meant for administrators only check that you have a token, not who you are.

steps.title: Get a token
steps.prompt: Which request header carries the API token?

steps.title: Find the endpoint
steps.prompt: Which admin endpoint returns every user's record? (its path)

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which OWASP API Security Top 10 risk is a regular user calling an admin function? (its name)

steps.title: Name the second flaw
steps.prompt: The records come back with every field, password included. Which API risk is that? (its name)
